achievements.name: First Week Survivor
achievements.description: Survive until Day 7 in the wasteland.

achievements.name: Two-Week Endurance
achievements.description: Survive until Day 14 under persistent fallout pressure.

achievements.name: Month of Ash
achievements.description: Survive 30 days in the holdfast against all odds.

achievements.name: No Casualties
achievements.description: Maintain a full living roster with zero casualties.

achievements.name: Low Exposure
achievements.description: Keep average radiation dose across survivors below 20 mSv.

achievements.name: Healthy Cohort
achievements.description: Maintain average survivor physical health above 80 points.

achievements.name: Perimeter Secured
achievements.description: Successfully repel 3 perimeter security threats or wasteland raids.

achievements.name: Iron Defense
achievements.description: Win a tactical encounter with zero survivor trauma or limb injuries.

achievements.name: Harmonious Bunker
achievements.description: Raise and sustain average shelter morale at or above 75 points.

achievements.name: Conflict Arbitrator
achievements.description: Mediate and peacefully resolve 3 interpersonal or ideological disputes.

achievements.name: Wasteland Cartographer
achievements.description: Survey and map 5 distinct route corridors across the irradiated wastes.

achievements.name: Deep Reconnaissance
achievements.description: Successfully complete a long-range expedition beyond 100 kilometers.

achievements.name: Honest Commerce
achievements.description: Conduct 5 successful barter trades with regional merchant caravans.

achievements.name: Full Granary
achievements.description: Accumulate a reserve of over 100 preserved rations in shelter storage.

achievements.name: Beacon of Hope
achievements.description: Offer sanctuary, medical aid, or mercy in 3 critical moral dilemmas.

achievements.name: Dignity Preserved
achievements.description: Honor fallen survivors with solemn memorialization and inheritance delivery.
